latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Photo to Video AI — convert your photos into shareable videos with ease.

- Instantly turn uploaded JPG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC images (up to 200MB) into animated videos with transitions and background music.
- Automatic setup with free authentication (100 credits, valid for 7 days); no complex installation needed.
- Supports common workflows: batch uploads, quick edits, iterative refinements, and downloadable 1080p MP4 exports.
- Simple, intent-based commands for exporting, checking credits, status, and managing uploads.
- Cloud GPU rendering ensures fast (30-90s) turnarounds and high-quality outputs without local hardware.
- Built-in handling for common errors, file types, and session management for a seamless experience.
